plugins.name: issue-flow
plugins.description: From the request to the merge request, by way of an issue that holds the plan and the roadmap that carries it out; for big developments, a project roadmap split into issues run in sequence; and, before anything else, a proposal of next steps read from the project's documentation. Works on GitLab (glab) and GitHub (gh).
